the void fraction is larger in horizontal tube than that of vertical one, which is in good agreement with the results in literature.
the void fraction of the present work is lower than the predictions of the most widely used correlations, especially at high mass flux and low vapor quality.

the void fraction in horizontal tubes is larger compared to that in vertical tubes and the void fraction increases with mass flux.
the flow regime and void fraction of the horizontal tubes are not the same as those of the vertical tubes.
